Name: Natural Mini Farm
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

[size=3]Custom Small Natural Farm, adds this farm to your game. Since it does not replace your Vanilla farms feel free to try it.[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]

On this farm you will catch some unusual fish and fishing here is a good earner, it has a working minecart, a boat to go directly to the beach, it has forest forage and when you are out of energy you can take a relaxing bath in the creek, it has everything you need in a farm but in a confined space. Do you think you can achieve perfection when space is limited?

[/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3][size=3]Additional information about the farm:[/size][/size][/color][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][size=3]
[color=#f4f4f4]-On this farm you can fish:[/color][color=#00ffff]sturgeon, catfish, goby, woodskip, largemouth bass, bullhead, river jelly, green algae[/color], [/size][/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=3][size=3]regardless of seasons or rain[/size][/size][/color][color=#b6d7a8], [/color][color=#f4f4f4]this is to make fishing more profitable and also because I love those fish.[size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=3]-[/size][/color][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][color=#00ffff]The boat has a one-way trip to the boat on the beach near Elliot's house, here's why:[/color] [/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=3]the boat on the beach near Elliot's house is just a decorative element, if you hover the mouse over it it doesn't do anything, on this farm instead I put the boat, both as a decorative element, but also as a one-way trip to the beach, I gave it a utility, because unlike the minecart which has a network throughout Stardew Valley, the boat does not have it.[/size][/color]

I recommend using it together with one or more of these mods to increase the planting and building space: 

To have more building and planting space:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28346]Enchanted Garden (PIF)             [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26936]
[/url]To have more free planting space: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26936]Large Greenhouse (PIF)[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22543]Secret Greenhouse (PIF)
[/url]
Also  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19498]Green Farm Cave[/url] will give more space for planting.

English and Italian languages with i18n for translations into other languages.

Installation:
Extract and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.
-Remember to install the dependencies for everything to work properly.

Enjoy! <3
